ValidationRule.description: A sale can only close if the customer came through a converted Lead. Account.From_Converted_Lead__c is stamped by the Lead_Conversion_Stamp_Account flow.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"), OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(StageName)), NOT(Account.From_Converted_Lead__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This opportunity can't be closed: the customer didn't come from a converted Lead. Record them as a Lead and convert it first.
